question.question_text: Describe the sequence of activities the camera wearer performed in the kitchen related to food preparation.

answer_options.text: The camera wearer began by preparing base ingredients, followed by systematic cooking and seasoning, culminating in the addition of vegetables to the stew.
The camera wearer began by marinating meat ingredients, followed by haphazard frying and tasting, interspersed with waste accumulation, culminating in the garnishing of the dish.

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer began by preparing base ingredients, specifically cutting onions and garlic, followed by systematic cooking and seasoning. The process included cutting ginger, discarding red bell peppers, and picking mushrooms. The camera wearer then stirred the food with a wooden spoon, turned on the cooker, and added water to the pot. Later, the camera wearer added vegetables to the stew and adjusted the lid on the pot. The sequence involved kitchen organization, such as opening drawers and using utensils, and included actions like waste disposal and plating.

evidence_index.source_content: Camera wearer places onion on chopping board, picks up knife, and cuts onion into pieces while moving it on the board with left hand.
Camera wearer picks up garlic, cuts ginger with knife and picks it up from board, then puts knife down on chopping board.
Camera wearer opens and closes drawer, picks up red bell pepper and discards it in trash bin, picks mushrooms from tray and places on chopping board, then puts garlic on sink.
Camera wearer places phone on table, then picks up garlic from chopping board and cuts it with knife, dropping and picking up garlic multiple times during the process.
Camera wearer stirs mushrooms with wooden spoon and scoops some, puts spoon on board and picks up knife, then stirs food in pot and turns cooker knob, continuing to stir food with spoon.
Camera wearer opens drawer and picks up spoon, opens jar lid, pours water into pot and places pot on sink, stirs pot with right hand and moves pot towards sink.
Camera wearer repeatedly picks up mushrooms from chopping board alternating hands, stirs rice with spoon, and stirs food while turning on cooker.

Camera wearer picks up container with spoon, turns on cooker and picks up kettle, wipes glass with towel, puts lid on pot and stirs food, picks up bag of vegetables and pours into pan, walks towards fridge, and stirs pot contents while adjusting lid.
